title: Silent virtual host machine
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine with $m$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states in $S$. The silent virtual host machine is obtained by applying the silent-tape embedding to the virtual host machine built from $M$, using the last tape as the cap tape.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a deterministic machine with $m$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states in $S$
caveat: The formal statement depends on the silent-tape embedding, whose defining behavior is not included in the supplied definitions.
